title: standalone Electron shell
summary: A local Electron shell embedding the platform. NATO alphabet name (alpha, bravo, ...). It is a local process, not a box: it has no SSH access, and it allocates every port through listen(0), so a running instance has no address knowable from outside.

fields.comment: the app repository carrying the Electron shell
VPATH_STANDALONE_HOME -- runtime state, keys and KPs
location question 1 -- where this instance lives (host + filesystem)
location question 2 -- where its build process lives
location question 3 -- which source repositories the build pulls apps from

fields.example: <registry-url, or 'none -- no containers on a standalone'>
fields.comment: location question 4 -- where the container images live
base URL of a running OntoGate viewer for this project's Spine; leave unset if none runs
live | planned -- 'planned' means agreed but not built yet
